base_object: finite sequence of pairwise distinct real numbers
legal_move: delete an interior current term lying strictly between its two current neighbours
proved_core: original endpoints plus original local maxima and minima
strong_deletability: every original non-core term remains legally deletable until removed
reachable_state_structure: Boolean lattice on the original non-core terms
next_priority: enumerate permutations by survivor count and connect the distribution to alternating runs
